name: gizza-ai/media-info
summary: Report an audio or video file's container, codecs, duration, and stream metadata.

tool.description: Inspect an audio or video file and report its container format, total duration, overall bitrate, and a per-track summary — codec (AAC/MP3/FLAC/ALAC/Opus/Vorbis/PCM/ADPCM/etc.), stream kind (audio or video), sample rate, channel count and layout (mono/stereo/5.1), and bit depth. Reads the bytes directly without re-encoding. Recognised containers: MP4/M4A/MOV, Matroska/WebM, OGG, WAV, AIFF, CAF, FLAC, MP3, and AAC/ADTS. Provide the file as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: File URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
